hero.headline: Building Excellence Across the Seas.
hero.description: Pioneering state-of-the-art superyacht manufacturing, precision commercial vessel construction, and bespoke naval engineering. Operating from world-class shipyard facilities in Tuzla, Türkiye, we combine centuries of maritime craftsmanship with cutting-edge hydrodynamics.
